Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) Notification under Section 7 Ref No: 3/2/6/12/682/කැළ /164(iv) It is hereby notified under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition Act (Amendment) No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitude which is required for a public purpose. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/servitude are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat of Kelaniya on the 19th June 2024 at 9.30 a.m. Further, it shall be notified to me through a written document in duplicate on or before the 05th June 2024, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such

amount. Deeds and other documents to prove the ownership also shall be presented on the date of the inquiry. A. A. D. C. Nൺൽൾൾඌඁൺඇං Aආൺඋൺඌංඇ඀ඁൾ, Divisional Secretary. Divisional Secretariat, Kelaniya. 01st December 2023 EOG 03 - 0040
